I kept the `str.format` version. The note says `{0}` stays literal, but `str.format` does substitute it. Joining the format string and the element would give `'temp{0}1'`, which fails your assertion that expects `'temp1'`.

```python
def add_string(lst, fmt):
    return [fmt.format(x) for x in lst]
```
